response.justification: The candidate is an experienced and versatile full-stack engineer (15+ years) with strong web, backend, and tooling skills, but the profile does not align with the core mandatory requirements. C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 plus a university thesis project, far short of the required 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. The stack is Linux/cloud/JavaScript-centric, database experience is MongoDB/MySQL rather than SQL Server or Oracle, and there is no fixed income, derivatives, or capital-markets domain experience — RIDE Capital is the closest touchpoint but is a retail investment/fintech context, not investment banking systems. Strong engineering fundamentals and communication ability do not offset the absence of every mandatory technical and domain criterion.
strengths: Broad, long-tenured engineering experience across web, embedded, and low-latency systems
Demonstrated communication skills via conference talks, workshops, and courses
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, Docker, open-source library authorship
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ work, over a decade ago, not on Windows
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain experience
No SQL Server or Oracle experience; databases are MongoDB/MySQL
